en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a large, ornate castle-like mansion with multiple turrets and a central tower flying a flag. The building stands on a hill, partly screened by mature trees. In the foreground, several well-dressed people in late-19th- or early-20th-century attire sit and stand on an open field, as if picnicking or posing. To the right below the hill are smaller houses or outbuildings with simple roofs. In the distant left background, a tall, slender tower or possible minaret rises above a wooded ridge. No printed caption or other visible text appears on the image.
